tool.name: FoldMason LDDT
tool.description: score a protein alignment using its structures
tool.command: #import re @LINK_STRUCTURES@ foldmason createdb structures/* structure_db --threads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" && foldmason msa2lddt structure_db '$alignment' --pair-threshold $pair_threshold --threads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" > '$scores'

param.name: alignment
param.label: Amino acid alignment
param.help: Aligned protein FASTA with identifiers matching the structure dataset names.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Compute the structure-based Local Distance Difference Test (LDDT) score of an existing amino acid multiple sequence alignment. This is useful for comparing alignments of the same protein structures.
**Inputs**
Supply the original PDB/mmCIF structure datasets and an aligned protein FASTA. Structure dataset names must match the FASTA identifiers after removing file extensions and replacing special characters with underscores. Use the same names as in the FoldMason alignment tool.
**Output**
A text report containing the average MSA LDDT score and scoring details. A higher LDDT score indicates greater structural agreement. This requires atomic coordinates; ProstT5 sequence predictions cannot be scored this way.
